session.summary: Planning a beginner's vegetable garden in a backyard with focus on suitable vegetables, supplies, layout, planting schedule, and pest control for zone 7b climate.

records.title: Beginner Vegetable Garden Project Plan
records.content: A comprehensive plan for starting a small vegetable garden in the backyard, tailored for beginners with actionable steps and considerations for zone 7b climate.
records.description: Detailed project plan for initiating a backyard vegetable garden with sections for layout, supplies, and schedule.

sections.heading: Garden Layout
sections.content: Plan for a small beginner garden bed of 4 feet by 8 feet, located in a spot receiving approximately 6 hours of sunlight daily. Need to confirm if this sunlight duration is sufficient for most vegetables.

sections.heading: Supplies Needed
sections.content:
- Soil
- Containers or raised bed materials
- Seeds (tomatoes, lettuce, others TBD)
- Basic gardening tools
- Watering system (consider simple drip irrigation)

sections.heading: Planting Schedule Overview
sections.content: Target to have everything planted by early May. Detailed planting calendar to be referenced separately for specific timing of each vegetable.

sections.heading: Additional Considerations
sections.content:
- Research companion planting (e.g., basil near tomatoes for better growth).
- Address pest control, especially for rabbits observed in the neighborhood; explore natural pest deterrents and fencing options.
